title: defect-claim/v1
description: nodes/<id>/defects/<timestamp>-<contributor>.yaml, or targets/<id>/defs/defects/<timestamp>-<contributor>.yaml (D-16; F08-R7): a statement-defect claim, free and shaped. Mechanical pre-triage: the class is from the taxonomy, the line is an existing line of the referenced Statement.lean or defs/ file, and the exhibit is a Lean file — or the claim bounces, in the service and again in the gate (D-35). The exhibit elaborates in the sandbox (C9). Adjudication is D-17's, Stage 1.

stmt_ref.description: the node id whose Statement.lean is claimed defective, or defs/<file>.lean under the target
